description: This file declares external function prototypes for the Daemon Socket Udp Object in the ANSC framework. It includes creation, removal, and initialization functions, serving as an interface for other modules to interact with the UDP socket object.

methods.name: AnscCreateDaemonSocketUdp
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Daemon Socket UDP object with provided context handles.

methods.name: AnscDkuoCreate
methods.description: Creates the Daemon Socket Udp object with specified context handles.

methods.name: AnscDkuoRemove
methods.description: Removes the Daemon Socket Udp object identified by the handle.

methods.name: AnscDkuoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls the internal objects required by the Daemon Socket Udp object.

methods.name: AnscDkuoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Daemon Socket Udp object.
